## Intro to clines

Clines are gradients of traits or allele frequencies typically formed by the tension between gene flow (or sometimes drift) and selection

\begin{figure}
\includegraphics[width = 0.6\linewidth]{images/cline_intro.png}
\end{figure}  

([UCL](https://www.ucl.ac.uk/~ucbhdjm/courses/b242/Hz/Hz.html))
